questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the Demand Management application in ServiceNow?

options.text: To capture, centralize, and assess strategic and operational demands

explanation.correct: The Demand Management application consists of tools for capturing, centralizing, and assessing strategic and operational demands. It provides a single location for managing all demand information and facilitates a structured approach to demand management.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Incidents and problems are tracked in ITSM applications, not Demand Management
Change requests are managed in Change Management, not Demand Management
Financial reports are created in Financial Management, not Demand Management

source.excerpt: The Demand Management application consists of tools for capturing, centralizing, and assessing strategic and operational demands.

questions.question: To what types of work items can a qualified demand be promoted? (Choose FOUR)

explanation.correct: Demands can be promoted to projects, enhancements, changes, or defects. The demand workbench provides a single point of engagement for assessing and approving demands and creating these work items.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Incidents are created from service disruptions, not promoted from demands
Knowledge articles are created in Knowledge Management, not promoted from demands

source.excerpt: Use the Demand Management application or the demand workbench to compare and assess demands, and promote demands to projects, enhancements, changes, or defects.

questions.question: What visualization tool in the demand workbench plots demands based on risk, value, and size?

explanation.correct: A bubble chart is a graph that plots multiple demands based on three categories: risk, value, and size. Each demand is represented by a circle that varies in size and color depending on the average scores for these categories.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Gantt charts are used for project scheduling, not demand visualization in the workbench
Pie charts show proportional data, not multi-dimensional demand analysis
Line charts show trends over time, not demand risk/value/size analysis

source.excerpt: A bubble chart is a graph that plots multiple demands based on three categories: risk, value, and size.

questions.question: How does the Demand Management application streamline the stakeholder identification process?

options.text: By sending emails to all users in the system
By auto-populating stakeholders from the portfolio selected when filling out the demand form
By requiring manual entry of all stakeholders
By importing stakeholders from external systems only

explanation.correct: The Demand Management application streamlines the stakeholder identification process by auto-populating the list of stakeholders from the portfolio the user selects when filling out the demand form in the service catalog or in the Demand Management application.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Stakeholders are not identified by sending emails to all users
The process is streamlined by auto-population, not manual entry
Stakeholders come from the selected portfolio, not external systems

source.excerpt: The Demand Management application streamlines the stakeholder identification process. Auto-populating the list of stakeholders from the portfolio the user selects when filling out the demand form.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a typical workflow activity for a demand manager?

options.text: Assess the feasibility, effort, and cost of the demand
Create demand tasks for specialized resources
Assign incidents to technical support groups
Create a business case for approval of the demand

explanation.correct: Assigning incidents to technical support groups is part of Incident Management, not Demand Management. A demand manager typically works on assessing feasibility, effort, and cost, creating demand tasks, and building business cases for demand approval.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Assessing feasibility, effort, and cost is a core demand manager responsibility
Creating demand tasks for specialized resources is part of the demand manager workflow
Creating a business case for approval is a key demand manager activity

source.excerpt: Work on a demand to assess the feasibility, effort, and cost of the demand and create a business case for approval of the demand.

questions.question: What fields are displayed on the Create an Idea form in Innovation Management?

explanation.correct: The Create an Idea form contains Title (brief description of the idea), Category (to associate with your idea - you can select multiple), and Description (detailed description of the idea including why it's useful, who would benefit, and how it would work).

wrongAnswers.explanation: Priority and Assignment Group are incident fields, not idea form fields
Short Description, State, and Impact are common task fields, not idea-specific fields
Name, Type, and Duration are not the primary fields on the Idea form

source.excerpt: Title - Brief description of the idea. Category - The category to associate with your idea. Description - Detailed description of the idea.

questions.question: Which indicators are displayed on the Idea Manager dashboard? (Choose THREE)

explanation.correct: The Idea Manager dashboard includes indicators for Open Ideas (count of ideas in Submitted, Need more information, or Under Review state), Average Age of Open Ideas, and Ideas Converted (count of ideas converted into work entities like demand, project, story, or epic).

wrongAnswers.explanation: Total Revenue Generated is a financial metric, not an idea management indicator
Change Success Rate is a Change Management metric, not an idea management indicator

source.excerpt: Open Ideas - Count of ideas in Submitted, Need more information, or Under Review state. Average Age of Open Ideas. Ideas Converted - Count of ideas converted into different work entities.

questions.question: What happens when a demand task is created and assigned to a resource?

options.text: The resource automatically approves the demand
The assigned resource posts time spent using a time card, which is used to calculate actual effort and cost
The demand is automatically promoted to a project
The resource receives a notification but cannot track time

explanation.correct: When resources are assigned to demand tasks, they post time spent while working on the demand or demand task using a time card. The time card data is then used to calculate actual effort and cost incurred on the demand task as well as the demand.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Working on a demand task does not automatically approve the demand
Demand promotion is a separate decision, not automatic from task assignment
Resources can track time through time cards when working on demand tasks

source.excerpt: The resources assigned to the demand tasks then post time spent while working on a demand or demand task using a time card. The time card data is used to calculate actual effort and cost incurred.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about Ideas and Categories is TRUE?

I. You can select multiple categories for a single idea.
II. Categories are visible to other users when viewing submitted ideas.
III. Ideas can only have one category assigned.
IV. Categories are hidden from users viewing the Idea Portal.

explanation.correct: You can select multiple categories for an idea, and categories are visible to other users in the Idea Portal when viewing submitted ideas. This helps users find and understand ideas more easily.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Both statements III and IV are false; multiple categories are allowed and they are visible
Statement II is also true; categories are visible in the Idea Portal
Statement III is false; you can select multiple categories for an idea

source.excerpt: Category - The category to associate with your idea. You can select multiple categories for an idea. Categories are also visible to other users in the Idea Portal when viewing submitted ideas.

questions.question: A demand represents a significant multi-year investment and needs to distribute funding across related work. What must be true to allocate funds from the demand?

options.text: The demand must be in Draft state
The Investment Funding plugin must be activated and an investment record must exist for the demand
The demand must have all tasks completed
The demand must be promoted to a project first

explanation.correct: To allocate funds from a demand, you must have the Investment Funding plugin activated, an existing corresponding investment record for the demand, and the investment_user role. This allows you to directly support projects, epics, or programs linked to the approved demand.

wrongAnswers.explanation: The demand state is not the primary requirement; the Investment Funding plugin and investment record are required
Task completion is not a requirement for fund allocation
Fund allocation can happen at the demand level; promotion to project is not required

source.excerpt: This link appears only if you have the Investment Funding plugin activated, an existing corresponding investment record for this demand, and the investment_user role.

questions.question: What are the two demand visualization tools provided with the Demand Management application? (Choose TWO)

explanation.correct: The Demand Management application comes with two demand visualization tools: the demand workbench (which provides a single point of engagement for assessing demands with an interactive bubble chart) and the demand roadmap (a visual representation of demands over time).

wrongAnswers.explanation: Project Gantt charts are part of Project Management, not demand visualization
Resource heatmap is part of Resource Management, not Demand Management

source.excerpt: The Demand Management application comes with two demand visualization tools that can aid decision makers with demand assessment.
